topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can’t believe they just left it there, out in the open, as if it’s nothing. Now it’s everywhere, those thoughts they kept locked away. Who does that? Just leaves their secrets scattered around? It’s like they don’t care, don’t understand what it means. I’ve seen it, all the things they wrote, the places they want to go, the things they want to do. It’s not fair. I’ve been here, wondering, watching, and now this. It should have been private, just for them. Now, I can’t unsee it, can’t pretend I don’t know. It’s like they’ve invited me into their head without asking, and I don’t like it. Not one bit.
